episodes.title: Bond Market Turbulence, France's Fiscal Reckoning and Europe's China Dilemma
episodes.summary:
**Summary**
Capital Economics' weekly briefing covers the global bond sell-off (10-year UST yields up ~100bp since end-June to 5.25%, now stabilizing), France's deepening fiscal crisis and widening spread versus Italy, a narrow US equity rally masking broad softness, and the EU Trade Commissioner's Beijing visit amid rising EU-China friction. All are first-order inputs to the global rates/risk backdrop that EM trades off.

**Key points**
- UST 10-year yields fell ~10bp Thursday to 5.25%, still ~100bp higher than end-June; driver is higher energy prices lifting Fed tightening expectations plus strong US data surprises and AI productivity optimism — fundamentals, not dysfunction.
- France-Italy bond spread hit a record high; France's primary deficit (ex-interest) is ~3% of GDP vs Italy's more stable ~3% headline deficit; political fragmentation blocks consolidation. No repeat of 2010-12 crisis given stronger ECB toolkit.
- S&P 500 at record highs but ~75% of index constituents are 10%+ below their own highs — rally concentrated in mega-cap IT.
- EU hardening stance on China trade (Macron/Merz joint letter), more anti-dumping/anti-subsidy tools likely, but no US-style tariff war; Germany now backing a tougher line.

**FX / rates implications**
- Higher-for-longer UST yields and Fed repricing (energy-driven, not panic-driven) support continued USD/DXY firmness and keep pressure on EM carry trades (INR, IDR, PHP, MXN, BRL rates) via higher US real rates.
- EUR vulnerable to French fiscal headline risk; eurozone periphery spreads (France vs Italy, Bunds) are a volatility signal worth tracking for broader risk sentiment.
- Narrow equity rally signals fragile risk-on backdrop — a reversal in mega-cap tech could trigger a broader risk-off that typically hits EM FX hard.
- Firmer EU stance on Chinese import competition could add to China growth/trade headwinds, an indirect drag on commodity-linked EM (CLP copper, COP/BRL metals/agri).

**Watch list**
- UST 10-year yield path around the 5% threshold and Fed rate-expectation repricing.
- French parliamentary budget debate and France-Italy spread trajectory.
- Further EU measures (anti-dumping probes, diversification tools) following the Beijing trade visit.
